original_evidence.text: | Ghostty | https://github.com/ghostty-org/ghostty | Zig core + Swift/AppKit (macOS app); GTK4 (Linux) | Y — macOS build only, via the Sparkle framework. Linux/GTK build has no in-app updater (distro/package-manager only; grep of `src/apprt/gtk/**` found no update-check code) | chk: manual by default — `SUEnableAutomaticChecks=false` in Info.plist force-disables `automaticallyChecksForUpdates`/`automaticallyDownloadsUpdates` regardless of the app's own `auto-update` config option; user must invoke "Check for Updates" manually. (A config-driven auto chk/dl code path exists but is currently short-circuited off by the plist flag.) | Y — once the user approves an update in the UI, Sparkle downloads and installs the package and relaunches the app | https — appcast feed URLs `https://tip.files.ghostty.org/appcast.xml` and `https://release.files.ghostty.org/appcast.xml`; TLS handled by Sparkle/URLSession defaults, no ATS exceptions or cert-bypass code found in `macos/` | N (the appcast XML itself is fetched over plain HTTPS with no outer signature; integrity of the file list/versions relies on TLS) | signature (EdDSA / Ed25519) — Sparkle verifies each release enclosure's `edSignature` before installing | Embedded public key baked into the app bundle at build time: `SUPublicEDKey` = `wsNcGf5hirwtdXMVnYoxRIX/SqZQLMOsYlD3q3imeok=` in `macos/Ghostty-Info.plist` | macos/Ghostty-Info.plist:107-110 (`SUEnableAutomaticChecks`=false, `SUPublicEDKey`); macos/Sources/App/AppDelegate.swift:768-788 (sync logic: plist flag overrides user config); macos/Sources/Features/Update/UpdateDelegate.swift:14-15 (feed URLs per channel); macos/Sources/Features/Update/UpdateController.swift, UpdateDriver.swift, UpdateViewModel.swift (Sparkle `SPUStandardUpdaterController`/`SUAppcastItem` usage). |
